citazioni.x: You can use your UK Blue Badge when travelling in some European countries.
Before visiting a country, check whether it recognises the UK Blue Badge. Some countries may require you to display a local parking notice as well as your Blue Badge.

Even in countries that recognise the Blue Badge, parking rules can vary in different parts of the country. Rules can also change, and some countries may have changed their rules since the pages linked to this guidance page were published.

You should research local parking regulations or get in touch with the relevant local authority for specific information. Local tourist information centres can also provide advice on parking rules for disabled people and may tell you about any specific requirements or restrictions in the area you are visiting.
For up-to-date information always check the local parking rules of the place you want to use your Blue Badge before parking.
make sure that your Blue Badge is displayed correctly and that you comply with any additional requirements, such as displaying a parking disc in countries such as Denmark

We recommend that you carry any supporting documentation that may be required, such as a doctor’s note or a translation of your Blue Badge, especially when travelling to countries with stricter parking rules.
The UK is working with Spain to ensure mutual recognition of parking permits for disabled people.
Parking concessions vary in each country.
The Blue Badge is recognised in some European countries and allows you to make use of the same parking concessions as the country’s own citizens with disability.
Parking concessions for holders of a disabled parking card differ from country to country - check the rules in the country you’re visiting.

We will work to sign an arrangement in order to ensure mutual recognition of parking permits for Disabled persons, as established under the UK Blue Badge Scheme and Spanish legislation, for travel between the UK and Spain.
If you have a disability that leads to reduced mobility, you might be entitled to an EU disability parking card in your country of residence, which should be recognised in all EU countries.
When you use your card you should display it at the front of the vehicle. The front of the card must be clearly visible for checking purposes.
Before travelling to another EU country, check the conditions applicable in that country.
This new parking card will guarantee the use of parking spaces and facilities reserved for persons with disabilities in all EU countries and will replace national parking cards.

To facilitate free movement of persons with disabilities around the EU, the Directive (EU) 2024/2841, adopted in October 2024, established a new European Disability Card and an improved European Parking Card for persons with disabilities.

When travelling across the EU, cardholders will be able to benefit from such special conditions or preferential treatment on equal terms and conditions as residents with disabilities in the Member State they visit.
The cards are meant for short stays of up to 3 months, with an exception for card holders that participate in an EU mobility programme in another Member State.
The special conditions can apply when using transport, attending cultural events and visiting museums, leisure and sports centres, amusement parks, and more.

The European Disability Card will benefit EU citizens and their family members with recognised disability status or entitlement to specific services based on a disability by the competent authorities or bodies in their Member State of residence.
The Directive 2024/2842 extends the personal scope to third-country nationals legally residing in a Member State.

The improved European Parking Card will serve as proof of right to parking conditions and facilities reserved for persons with disabilities in all EU countries. It will also contain security features to prevent and combat fraud.

The European Parking Card will benefit EU citizens and their family members with recognised rights to parking conditions and facilities reserved for persons with disabilities by the competent authorities or bodies in their Member State of residence.
By 5 December 2029, the European Parking Card will replace national parking cards for persons with disabilities.

By 5 June 2027, Member States have to adopt and publish the national laws and rules needed to implement Directives 2024/2841 and 2024/2842, and inform the Commission of those measures. Member States have to apply those measures from 5 June 2028. From that date, Member States have to issue the cards to eligible persons with disabilities.
assessment of remaining gaps related to the free movement of persons with disabilities (by 5 June 2029)

In July 2026, the Commission adopted a delegated regulation (C/2026/4534) setting out the QR codes to be used on the physical versions of the European Disability Card and the European Parking Card, to ensure the security and interoperability of both cards.
The cards remain a flagship initiative, with the aim of making them available in people’s digital wallets.

This initiative is built on the experience of the ongoing EU Disability Card pilot project launched in February 2016 in eight EU countries and the EU parking card for persons with disabilities based on Council Recommendation 98/376/EC.

You can access to the national EU Disability Card websites of: Belgium Cyprus Finland Italy Malta Romania Slovenia In addition, Croatia has implemented an EU-funded project to already support the introduction of both cards.

The Directive does not affect Member States’ competence to determine the conditions for assessing and recognising disability status or the entitlement to specific services based on a disability, or for granting the right to parking conditions and facilities reserved for persons with disabilities.

Il Blue Badge rilasciato dalle competenti autorità del Regno Unito (Inghilterra, Scozia, Galles e Irlanda del Nord) deve essere riconosciuto come pienamente valido sul territorio italiano, purché in corso di validità e conforme alle caratteristiche grafiche standard del modello britannico recante il simbolo internazionale della sedia a ruote (Allegato A).
citazioni.tr: The Blue Badge issued by the competent UK authorities (England, Scotland, Wales and Northern Ireland) must be recognised as fully valid in Italy, provided that it is in date and matches the standard design of the British model with the international wheelchair symbol (Annex A).

citazioni.x: I titolari di Blue Badge beneficiano dei medesimi diritti di parcheggio (es. uso degli stalli riservati alle persone con disabilità) e di circolazione (es. accesso alle Zone a Traffico Limitato - ZTL, ove regolamentato dai singoli Comuni ai sensi dell'art. 7 del Codice della Strada) previsti per i titolari di Contrassegno Unificato Disabili Europeo (CUDE) italiano.
citazioni.tr: Blue Badge holders have the same parking rights (for example the use of the bays reserved for people with disabilities) and traffic rights (for example access to Limited Traffic Zones – ZTL, where each town regulates this under article 7 of the Highway Code) as holders of the Italian European disabled parking card (CUDE).

citazioni.x: Il Blue Badge deve essere esposto in modo ben visibile sulla parte anteriore del veicolo (cruscotto o parabrezza), al fine di consentire i necessari controlli da parte degli organi di polizia stradale e degli ausiliari del traffico.
citazioni.tr: The Blue Badge must be displayed clearly at the front of the vehicle (dashboard or windscreen), so that the traffic police and traffic wardens can check it.

citazioni.x: L'Italia riconosce la validità dei Contrassegni emessi dal Regno Unito (blue badge), a seguito della Circolare del Ministero delle infrastrutture e dei trasporti del 28 settembre 2026 e del relativo allegato. Ai possessori di Blue Badge rilasciato dal Regno Unito sono garantiti i medesimi diritti di sosta e di circolazione riconosciuti ai titolari di Contrassegno di parcheggio UE emesso dagli altri Stati membri ai sensi della Raccomandazione 98/376/CE.
citazioni.tr: Italy recognises parking cards issued by the United Kingdom (Blue Badge), following the circular of the Ministry of Infrastructure and Transport of 28 September 2026 and its annex. Holders of a Blue Badge issued by the United Kingdom have the same parking and traffic rights as holders of an EU parking card issued by the other Member States under Recommendation 98/376/EC.

citazioni.x: Il Blue Badge deve essere sempre esposto in modo visibile dal parabrezza anteriore del veicolo e può essere utilizzato esclusivamente se il titolare è a bordo.
citazioni.tr: The Blue Badge must always be displayed so that it can be seen through the front windscreen, and it can be used only if the holder is in the vehicle.

citazioni.x: Il Contrassegno dà diritto al parcheggio negli spazi riservati (strisce gialle) segnalati tramite l'apposita cartellonistica stradale
citazioni.tr: The card gives the right to park in the reserved spaces (yellow lines) marked by the special road signs

citazioni.x: La sosta sulle strisce blu è completamente gratuita, senza limiti di orario, su tutto il territorio nazionale.
citazioni.tr: Parking in blue-line bays is completely free, with no time limit, throughout the country.

citazioni.x: Per i cittadini dei Comuni che hanno aderito alla Piattaforma unica nazionale delle targhe associate il passaggio nelle ZTL dei Comuni che hanno aderito alla Piattaforma è consentito anche senza previa o successiva autorizzazione da parte del Comune, a condizione che il cittadino abbia registrato la propria targa. Negli altri casi, consultare i canali del Comune di riferimento per richiedere l'autorizzazione all'accesso alle ZTL.
citazioni.tr: For residents of towns that have joined the national platform for associated number plates, driving into the ZTLs of towns that have joined the platform is allowed without asking the town for permission before or after, provided that the person has registered their number plate. In other cases, use the town’s channels to ask for permission to enter the ZTL.

citazioni.x: Per accedere alla piattaforma, è indispensabile che il richiedente presenti al Comune che ha emesso il Contrassegno la richiesta di adesione.
citazioni.tr: To use the platform, the applicant must send a request to join to the town (Comune) that issued the card.

citazioni.x: ATTENZIONE: In tutti gli altri Comuni che ancora non hanno aderito alla Piattaforma, continueranno a valere le modalità operative precedenti per segnalare il transito del proprio veicolo.
citazioni.tr: WARNING: in all the other towns that have not yet joined the platform, the previous procedures for reporting that your vehicle has driven through still apply.

citazioni.tr: “Stationnement” (parking) mention, which lets you park free of charge

citazioni.x: La carte vous permet, vous et la personne qui vous accompagne, d'utiliser gratuitement et sans limitation de durée toutes les places de stationnement ouvertes au public en France et dans l'ensemble des pays de l'Union européenne
citazioni.tr: The card lets you, and the person travelling with you, use free of charge and with no time limit all parking spaces open to the public in France and in every European Union country

citazioni.x: La commune peut toutefois décider de limiter la durée de stationnement, sans pouvoir la fixer à moins de 12 heures. Par ailleurs, une redevance peut être exigée pour l’accès aux parcs de stationnement équipés de bornes d’entrée et de sortie utilisables depuis votre véhicule.
citazioni.tr: However, the town (commune) can decide to limit how long you can park, but it cannot set the limit at less than 12 hours. Also, a fee can be charged to enter car parks with entry and exit barriers that you use from your vehicle.
